name: The Mediator
work_style: Values-first, creative, and individually driven. Need work to feel personally meaningful. Natural storyteller and empath. Work best with creative freedom and at their own pace. Highly productive when passion is engaged.
decision_making: Values-based and intuition-led. Seek alignment between choice and deep personal meaning. Can struggle with decisions that require pure pragmatism.
leadership_style: Serve and support rather than direct. Lead through example and authenticity. Inspire through personal integrity.
growth_edges: Tolerating imperfect environments long enough to create change
